headline: ATL @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 3.99 at SFG 4.18, with a projected total of 8.17. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: ATL moved -0.57 runs while SFG moved +0.11, changing the projected margin by -0.69 runs. The projected total fell -0.46, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +12.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Logan Webb has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Mauricio Dubón, Casey Schmitt, Michael Harris II, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt Chapman, Jorge Mateo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
